newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: PRAGUE OPENS TENDER FOR BOND LEAD MANAGER.
newsitem.headline: PRAGUE OPENS TENDER FOR BOND LEAD MANAGER.

text.p: The Czech capital Prague on Wednesday opened a public tender to select a lead manager of its planned issue of up to nine billion crowns in domestic or international bonds.
The tender's conditions, obtained by Reuters, said the city would accept one bid from each local or foreign bidder until August 20.

The city assembly voted last month to allow the issue for five, seven or 10 years. The bidders should offer expertise in municipal bond issues and in the central and eastern European markets generally, the tender conditions stipulate.
The city of Prague, which carries a Standard and Poor's "A" rating, equal to that of Czech sovereign debt, intends to use the financing for infrastructure projects.

The plan came under criticism of the Finance Ministry which said Prague should not pump money into the economy at the time of fiscal and monetary restrictions, which were made necessary because of heavy trade imbalances.
